declarations.title: Selected current container log samples have no detected secrets
declarations.description: Inspect at most 100 current-container log lines from the preceding fixed hour for each explicitly selected target. Both pinned offline detectors must complete for a clean sample; results do not establish secret absence in other logs or validate credentials.
declarations.remediation: Remove credential values from application logging and rotate confirmed exposed credentials. Restrict access to the affected Pod logs and use an appropriate secret reference for application configuration.

proposed_admission.mode: root atomic source-bound admission after review; no install function or registry hook here
proposed_admission.shared_dependencies: Pin exact used functions/AST/import edges, not whole mutable shared files; retain historical receipts unchanged.

future_shared_hooks.delta: Validate selected_k8s_log_samples against explicit namespace scopes before authentication; no caller-controlled runtime gates.
Add this kind to the K8s content gate only when this exact check ID is explicitly named.
Keep the new optional kind out of full default collection; inventories/collect_all never substitute for the explicit named-check gate.
Declare kind but exclude it from default inventories; no blanket discovery.
Only extend existing read-only path/query clause with allowed_request(path,query,self.selected_log_requests); preserve origin/body/escaping/redirect/retry checks.

Validate selectors pre-auth; after actual cluster binding invoke collect(reader,api,options,requested_scopes,cluster) only for selected kind; respect scope/resource limits with explicit unresolved target rows.

Merge new metadata and BOTH ephemeral literal/log redaction ledgers before one finalize() call; no cache/export/progress containing raw matches or identities. Skip auth capture for optional private reads and preserve unrelated inventory behavior.

future_shared_hooks.symbol: server option validation / registry / canonical metadata
future_shared_hooks.delta: Root-owned opt-in schema, Secrets/high metadata, source-bound admission and descriptions; no automatic numbered compliance edges.

Extend the existing optional-literal count-only progress scope suppression to this kind, avoid optional auth/context capture, and replace the existing no-pod-logs-read usage text with exact selected-current-sample coverage when enabled.

transport: Actual authenticated SDK headers and existing _BoundedPool; uncached GET only, no REST preload/error-body path.
api_version: core/v1; pinned v0.34.0 type definitions; local Kubernetes Python client version recorded in final report
coverage_limits: Returned sample only, not full-hour/all-log absence; at most last100 lines.
No server upper time bound or atomic UID/containerID precondition on log GET; outside-window/race is UNKNOWN.
Unobserved/waiting status, omitted identity or unsupported binary/partial/empty data is UNKNOWN.
No credential validation, previous logs, exec, Secret/reference reads, node/proxy, host or external code.
Wire debug must remain disabled throughout private reads; arbitrary concurrent SDK/logging/pool reconfiguration is unsupported.

A detected value in namespace scope is redacted by the existing literal union recipe; its changed scope becomes unavailable and the strict consumer returns UNKNOWN rather than clean or falsely rebound evidence.
Busy containers returning newer-than-capture records remain UNKNOWN because the native API has no upper-time query bound.
